name: Omanero
author: sette7blo
description: A small hot Monero wallet in the Omarchy bar, with no local node: it talks to a public node you pick, and your keys stay in an encrypted wallet file on this machine. Create a wallet or restore one from its 25-word seed, send after a review of address, amount, fee and total, receive with Copy and a QR code, and see recent payments. A browser extension adds Tip buttons to Monero addresses on X and GitHub, and you can tip plugin authors who publish one. Unaudited: keep pocket money in it.

barWidget.description: Send, receive, and tip Monero addresses from X, GitHub and other plugins. No local node.
